description.narrative: Core Support to ICADE will directly contribute to strengthening the human, organizational and productive capacities of the target population and social economy enterprises. By expanding and improving the offer of certification services—including audits and verifications against standards such as HCCP, SMETA, and ASI—the project will increase the competitiveness, food safety, and sustainability of local enterprises, generating greater economic opportunities for the most vulnerable groups. In a complementary way, the technical and financial strengthening of local institutions and organizations will allow better decision-making in the integrated management of natural resources, promoting sustainable practices that contribute to the protection, restoration and responsible use of the territory. By incorporating climate change mitigation and adaptation actions, the project will increase community resilience to disaster risks, reducing structural vulnerabilities. By accompanying social organization and encouraging advocacy, the project will promote favorable changes in public policies. Thus, progress will be made towards sustainable and inclusive human development, reducing multidimensional poverty and social exclusion, and consolidating a fairer model based on the social and solidarity economy.
